options.name: Form of the Bear
options.benefit: Gain +4 enhancement Strength while shifted, but base speed becomes 20 feet.

options.name: Form of the Cat
options.benefit: Gain +10 feet base speed and +4 Acrobatics and Climb while shifted.

options.name: Form of the Otter
